claims: Monitor respiratory status closely with continuous pulse oximetry and respiratory rate; patient is on 2 L/min O2 with recent respiratory rate of 33/min and SpO2 96-98%.

Obtain repeat basic metabolic panel including calcium, magnesium, and phosphate within 24 hours to reassess hypocalcemia (7.1 mg/dL), hypophosphatemia (1.4 mg/dL), and renal function (creatinine 1.3-1.5 mg/dL).
Continue supplemental potassium replacement and recheck serum potassium level given recent potassium 3.5 mEq/L.
Continue calcium carbonate and Neutra-Phos supplementation for hypocalcemia and hypophosphatemia, with follow-up electrolyte monitoring.
Assess and manage fever (temperature 100.7°F) with acetaminophen as ordered, and monitor temperature trends.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units as ordered.
Continue incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises to prevent atelectasis and support respiratory toilet.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen) given elevated fibrinogen 815 mg/dL and INR 1.4-1.5, and reassess need for further testing.
Perform urinalysis with microscopy if not already completed, given proteinuria 100 mg/dL and urine osmolality 969 mOsm/kg, to evaluate renal function.
Maintain fall precautions and bed rest with assistance for mobility as documented, given bed rest status and IV access.
